meta.what: Coal unit decommissioning years for the IRP-timing sensitivity (TODO 14cr): a unit listed here is gone from the start of the year given; every unit not listed keeps c4's date (UC_FLEET).
meta.basis: Tracks IRP 2025's total coal path, scaled to our 39,692 MW base (x 39,692/40,960). The path is from the plan's text, since Figure 3 (plan p.12, gazette p.23) could not be read here: 40,960 MW installed (Table 1); 8 GW gone by the start of 2030 (plan p.13); a further 15 GW in 12 equal steps at the starts of 2031 to 2042 (50-year end of life for Kendal, Majuba, Lethabo, Matimba and Tutuka from 2031, plan p.24; p.13 says 2034). Camden, Hendrina, Grootvlei and Arnot go at the start of 2030 (plan p.40, gazette p.51); then the oldest units first by start year (ties by the station's first unit, then unit order), retiring a unit in a year while the fleet stands at least half that unit above the path. Units still standing at the start of 2042 keep c4's date if later, else 2043; both lie beyond the model's last year (2040). User decisions, 12 Oct 2026.
meta.source_start_years: Global Energy Monitor, Global Coal Plant Tracker, unit tables on gem.wiki (Kelvin, Kriel, Matla, Duvha, Tutuka, Lethabo, Matimba, Kendal pages), read 12 Oct 2026. Units mapped to the fleet file's half-station groups in unit order (units 1-3 to *, 4-6 to **); Duvha's mothballed unit 3 is not in the fleet file; Kelvin's two fleet-file units take GEM's two oldest operating units (1962, 1964).
